item.summary: This journal entry initiates a research project on divergent values, analyzing how initial conditions and feedback loops lead to distinct preference hierarchies in learning agents. The investigation will bridge path-dependency in reinforcement learning with value divergence, treating preferences as emergent, stability-seeking states rather than static constraints. Research on memory recall and responsibility formation remains in queue to ensure compliance with the active topic constraint.
